title: Providence Over Suffering
definition: Providence over suffering means that God remains sovereign, wise, good, and near even when suffering is painful and mysterious.
summary: God can work through suffering without being absent from sufferers.
christFocus: Jesus suffered unjustly, yet through His suffering God accomplished redemption.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's providence includes suffering, but not in a simplistic or careless way. Scripture does not deny pain or call evil good. It teaches that God remains sovereign and able to work redemptively through what is painful.

The cross is the deepest proof. Human evil was real, suffering was real, and yet God's saving purpose was accomplished through Christ.

Believers may not understand why suffering comes, but they can trust the God who entered suffering and promises final restoration.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Sufferers often wonder whether God has lost control or stopped caring. Providence over suffering matters because it anchors pain in the hands of a wise and compassionate Lord.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring suffering honestly to God. Trust His providence without pretending pain is easy, and look to the cross when His purposes are hidden.
